text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to interview for appointment to the Toronto Zoo Board. Following the interviews, the Civic Appointments Committee will recommend three candidates for appointment to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Toronto Zoo Board: TZB2-99 TZB2-117 TZB2-126 TZB2-138 TZB2-151 TZB2-155 TZB2-158 TZB2-159 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (May 16, 2023) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals currently appointed or being considered for appointment to the Toronto Zoo Board.
